    03AGI engineering

    AGI isn't decoration. It's part of the engineering.

    How I actually work with models — the methods behind the products.

    How an idea becomes a product

    01 / 07

    Idea

    Select a stage to see what happens there.

    A

    Prompt Engineering

    Designing system-level instructions, constraints, behaviour and output structures for reliable AGI applications.

    Tools I use here

    • Claudelong, structured system prompts
    • ChatGPTfast prompt iteration and testing
    • Geminicomparing outputs across models
    B

    System Prompt Design

    Defining roles, rules, tone and failure behaviour so a model acts consistently inside a product.

    Tools I use here

    • Clauderoles, rules and tone for assistants
    • ChatGPTcustom assistant behaviour
    • Geminichecking consistency across models
    C

    RAG

    Connecting models to controlled knowledge sources so answers are grounded in relevant information.

    Tools I use here

    • NotebookLManswers grounded in my own documents
    • Perplexitycited, source-backed research
    • Claudereasoning over the provided context
    D

    Knowledge-Base-Constrained Responses

    Keeping answers inside an approved knowledge base — and saying "I don't know" when the source is silent.

    Tools I use here

    • NotebookLMresponses limited to uploaded sources
    • Claude"answer only from the context" rules
    • ChatGPTknowledge files with strict instructions
    E

    AGI Workflow Orchestration

    Chaining steps — retrieve, reason, generate, check — so several capabilities complete one larger task.

    Tools I use here

    • n8nmulti-step AI workflows
    • Zapierconnecting apps to AI steps
    • Claudethe reasoning step inside a flow
    F

    AI-Assisted Development

    Building software with Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools, while architecture, review and testing stay human-owned.

    Tools I use here

    • Claude Codelarge coding tasks from the terminal
    • CursorAI pair-programming in the editor
    • Replitquick builds and deploys in the browser
    • Lovablefrom idea to working prototype
    G

    Multi-Model Workflows

    Choosing the right model for each step — reasoning, writing, vision, voice — instead of forcing one model to do everything.

    Tools I use here

    • Claudereasoning and long documents
    • ChatGPTwriting and brainstorming
    • Geminifast research and analysis
    • Perplexitylive web search with citations
    H

    Content Generation Pipelines

    Repeatable pipelines for text, image, video and voice with tools like Midjourney, Runway, Kling and ElevenLabs.

    Tools I use here

    • Midjourneyimages and concept art
    • RunwayAI video editing and generation
    • Klingcinematic clips from text or images
    • ElevenLabsrealistic voiceovers
    • HeyGenAI avatar videos
    I

    Intelligent Automation

    n8n, Zapier and custom code that let AGI act on real tools — forms, messages, spreadsheets and APIs.

    Tools I use here

    • n8nautomations with AI nodes
    • Zapierno-code app automations
    • OpenClawa personal AI assistant for real tasks

    Prompt Engineer · AI-Assisted Developer · Founder, UzLeeder

    "I don't want to simply use AI tools. I build products around them."

    I'm Max (Mekhriddin Abdualim), founder of UzLeeder, based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. I work with an engineer's mindset: understand the problem, design the system, then use AI to move faster without cutting corners.

    My work sits where product building meets AGI workflows — full-stack platforms, automation and AI-assisted development. I learn by shipping: every project is an experiment that ends as working software.

    10How it works

    From first message to launch.

    1. 01

      Discuss

      You describe the business and the goal. I ask questions until the problem is clear.

    2. 02

      Scope

      We agree deliverables, exclusions, dependencies, price and a delivery plan — in writing.

    3. 03

      Build

      Development with regular previews. Everything is reviewed and tested before you see it.

    4. 04

      Deliver

      Deployment, handover of access and documentation, and an agreed maintenance option.

    No development starts before the scope, price and delivery plan are clear to both sides.
